briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 accelerate multi-agent race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month amid $11.9B quarterly funding. Multi-agent systems show rapid capability jumps while prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced agent orchestration; DeepSeek-R2 matched GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus leads in reasoning benchmarks while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2.1M units shipped; Microsoft and Google announced 50GW data center expansions through 2027. TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding supply by 40%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become the default standard before state actors exploit unpatched multi-agent systems?
